name: openbb_index_price_historical
description:
Daily price history for one market index through the OpenBB Platform (obb.index.price.historical), in OpenBB's default date window.
Returns: {tool, data_points (total rows), data: first 100 rows as OpenBB returns them} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): symbol (not marked required in the schema, but OpenBB needs it; e.g. ^GSPC or SPX depending on provider); provider (fmp, intrinio, polygon or yfinance; schema default fmp; when omitted the tool sends yfinance, which needs no key).
Other sources: yf_index_history; latest levels: yf_market_summary. Keys: fmp, benzinga, fred, intrinio, polygon and tiingo need credentials in OpenBB's settings (~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json), not supplied by SAJHA; yfinance, oecd, federal_reserve, sec, imf and government_us need none.
Example: {"symbol": "^GSPC", "provider": "yfinance"}
